monarchReviews.name: Isaac H.
monarchReviews.title: Amazing Custom PC and Customer Service
monarchReviews.body:
I ordered a custom computer from Ironside using the Forge a PC option, and customized it to my liking. I liked that I was able to ask for no Windows activation license as I use Linux, and did not want to pay for a license as I would not have used it. I also got an AMD GPU for the kernel available drivers.

After checkout a few days later I realized I forgot to add fans to my build, so I reached out to customer service via email and they were very friendly and quickly sent a link to pay for and add the fans to my build before shipping and when the computer arrived everything was pre-built to my customizations included the fans I asked for later.

Using the PC has been a blast and I have had no issues at all. Installed Bazzite, everything worked out of the box, all hardware was as ordered when I checked the system information, and games are running amazing. I would definitely recommend Ironside to anyone who wants a custom built gaming PC but does not have the time or knowledge to hunt for parts and build it themselves.

monarchReviews.name: Mairen M.
monarchReviews.title: Eden’s Veil Case is great!
monarchReviews.body:
Purchased the Eden Veil Case in Grimthorn XL for my (first) PC Build! It arrived quickly and in great condition. I was surprised that the Case’s Base was that of a different manufacturer/Designer: Fractal’s North Design XL. However, I’m not mad about it. It meant it was easier to find a guide online from somebody building with the case. Plus, the detailing is still just absolutely gorgeous. Some details from the OG case you miss in the pictures: gold/brass buttons and plugs along the top of the case that matches the wrapping on the feet, the spot for the power supply has a dust tray that can be easily removed for cleaning, and the metal side of the case has an extra plate with rubber grommets to hide the wiring behind! The XL is definitely bigger than I need, but I eventually want to switch to water cooling and it provides slots for the tubing in the top brackets. The design added by Ironside is pristine and beautiful; there were no scratches found. They kept the plastic film on the other side of the glass. I would’ve loved if they reapplied the film for the design side to give it extra smudge protection, especially as you take out the panel to build the PC. However, the packaging used was plenty to keep it safe during transit and generally unboxing! 

TL;DR despite my nitpicks, this is a *really* high quality case. I’m a longtime looker, first time purchaser and I’m glad I made the purchase.

monarchReviews.title: Reasonably priced, beautiful, handled with care
monarchReviews.body:
I have never bought a new PC before - I’ve always tinkered and upgraded whatever I had with whatever I could afford. This was my first new computer and a treat to myself, as I’ve dealt with some lingering health issues post cancer and don’t have the energy for projects like I used to. Ironside was prompt, thorough, and kind when I reached out with a question. They sent my new computer and it was packed really carefully, with extra parts and bonus stickers as a little gift. The computer performs great - I paid to have the fans optimized and they are SILENT.  one suggestion I would have is offering Linux as an alternative OS. I paid for windows 11 but almost immediately switched to Mint because Windows is so bloated and crappy. Obviously not an Ironside issue, just a thought. 

Overall, 10/10. Thanks for taking the time to make this computer with care.

monarchReviews.name: eviscer
monarchReviews.title: Dream PC
monarchReviews.body: Was doing some searching around for the perfect gaming PC. After reading some reviews, figured I would give Ironside Computers a chance. And not once have I regretted it at all. After having the PC for near a month, it runs like a dream. I bought the Model R series, and for the price, the quality, and how it runs, it's perfect. Knowing some bit about computers, but not a lot. The support was outstanding, helped me pick out the PC I was looking for within my budget, and over-all nice people to work with. For great quality, price, and support, Ironside Computers I highly recommend.

monarchReviews.name: samdaley
monarchReviews.title: best pc compnany
monarchReviews.body: one of the best prebuilt companies i've ever worked with. customer service was amazing and responsive the build of the pc was amazing and the price wasn't bad love them and have been using them for all my pc needs since 2017

monarchReviews.name: nim2687769468
monarchReviews.title: Great work. Long time customer.
monarchReviews.body: Just got my third pc. Last one was about 7-8 years ago and the first one was a few years before that so I can say their work is consistent in my experience. This third pc arrived with a no display issue (risk of shipping pc) but they were extremely quick with the support. Shipped it back and it was returned to me very quick despite the holidays. Great work and solid support.

monarchReviews.name: Dino
monarchReviews.title: Great case
monarchReviews.body: Great quality

monarchReviews.name: Jaxon Schultz
monarchReviews.title: Good PC, Good Support
monarchReviews.body: I ordered a PC back in October and it arrived on 11.3.25. I had issues with it randomly crashing up until yesterday when I called into customer support and spoke with Zach. Zach breezed through the issue in less than 30 minutes and got everything handled. The PC is a monster, and it runs like a dream now with the help of Zach. I would definitely recommend looking here for your pc and case concerns as these people truly care about their work and the people they sell to.

monarchReviews.name: Cheyenne
monarchReviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
monarchReviews.body: I was recommended Ironside for the purchase of a pre-built PC, and they have not disappointed. There are several different payment options available if you're on a budget, and they keep you updated on the progress of your build the whole time. Quick, efficient, and the PC is gorgeous to boot!

monarchReviews.name: Natalie
monarchReviews.title: Good PC!
monarchReviews.body: I got the Iron side strawberry milk PC. The company has been really great to deal with, their customer service is really great and responds quickly. PC works great and it was a very reasonable price for all the specs! Would buy a PC from them again.

monarchReviews.name: Dakota Dirden
monarchReviews.body: I absolutely would recommend ironside computers, they have been very helpful and they have very competent staff, I've purchased my pre-built pc from them a year and a half ago, and I've had no issues whatsoever. It's a great company for people getting into pc gaming, they have budget options and fully customizable options for every need.

monarchReviews.name: Dan
monarchReviews.title: The case of my dreams
monarchReviews.body: After years of waiting to start a new build, i finally jumped on starting. I saw the Nyanners collab case and it was love at first sight. The case is absolutely gorgeous! and it arrived earlier than expected too. Im so excited to build with this case in mind

monarchReviews.name: Kevin Tekancic
monarchReviews.title: Worth the wait
monarchReviews.body: I was very sad to miss out in the first drop of the JuiceBox cases. Once I saw the relaunch I immediately jumped on it and don't regret it! Fast shipping and well packaged 5 Stars 10/10

monarchReviews.name: Jasmine Heep
monarchReviews.title: A dream come true!
monarchReviews.body: I am beyond impressed. From the turnaround time of like 2 1/2 weeks to the packaging ( I'm pretty sure FedEx could have dropped this thing from 2 stories and it would have been fine there was so much bubble wrap ), to the craftsmanship of the product I received I could not be more satisfied with my experience with Ironside.

monarchReviews.name: Jessica
monarchReviews.title: Frostvine Eden's Veil PC Case
monarchReviews.body: I've had my build finished for a little over 2 months now and this case is SOOO perfect for my setup. It can be really difficult to match my setup's green/woodland/magical aesthetic sometimes, especially when so many gaming products out there follow the traditional edgy gamerboi look - I really appreciate how unique this case is. I will say, it does require significant RGBs for the full effect of the stained glass, especially at night (I'm ordering some extra fans), but it truly is lovely. My only other complaint is that the top/front 2 USB ports are very tight and difficult to get dongles in and out of...but still useable. Lookswise it's an 11/10 and my PC has been staying nice and cool. I love this case!!!

monarchReviews.name: Kyle Canevari
monarchReviews.title: Great customer service!
monarchReviews.body: I really wanted a Chocolate MilkBox pc but was worried as they were sold out. Customer service hooked me up super quick and helped make it happen! Super appreciated, and the case looks wonderful!

monarchReviews.name: ghampton
monarchReviews.title: Good build
monarchReviews.body: Overall good build and I love the art style.

monarchReviews.name: Julia
monarchReviews.title: Such a beautiful case!
monarchReviews.body: This case is absolutely beautiful! I was worried the glass paneling would just be a sticker but it is much better quality than that. Everything about this case has surpassed my expectations. It even came a whole week earlier than it was scheduled to which was even better! Definitely recommend this brand!

monarchReviews.name: Nikolaos
monarchReviews.title: Awesome Case
monarchReviews.body: Recently purchased the Edens Veil for a new build. Its an awesome upgrade to the already fantastic Fractal North Case. Very satisfied!

monarchReviews.name: Paige Westlund
monarchReviews.title: Beautiful product
monarchReviews.body:
I purchased the Eden's Veil case and it looks gorgeous.
My only issue was that prior to ordering, they took days to respond to an inquiry I had. After waiting for a few days with no reply, I placed the order anyways, but I would've liked communication within 48 hours. I believe they did eventually respond after about 5-7 days.

monarchReviews.name: Alexander Keeney
monarchReviews.title: Amazing case!
monarchReviews.body: I bought the black case and I love the design and I'm using it for a build and it's going to be sweet when it's done, thank you ironside for offering such a unique and stunning case
monarchReviews.product: Partner collab Lord Aethelstan black computer case

monarchReviews.name: Eun I
monarchReviews.title: Very satisfied!!
monarchReviews.body: It's been roughly ten days since receiving my PC and so far so good! They update you on the progress constantly so you aren't super anxious and the shipping was fast for me. I love my PC tower and it's also performing great. I'd definitely recommend this company if anyone is trying to buy a new PC.

monarchReviews.name: Basil Choudhry
monarchReviews.title: Amazing Case
monarchReviews.body: One of the best cases I have ever ordered. Would 100% get one again! And it got here very very quickly.

monarchReviews.name: Quintion DeLoach
monarchReviews.title: Incredible Craftmanship
monarchReviews.body: The quality of the printed designs far surpassed my expectations.  Very pleased with the work done by Ironside.
monarchReviews.product: Banana Milk Box Corsair 3500 PC case.

monarchReviews.name: Jack
monarchReviews.title: Great Build for a Great Price!
monarchReviews.body: I’ve built my fair share of PCs but there’s always the concern of doing something wrong, especially with how much tech has changed. Ironside makes it easy to order a custom built PC or a pre-built for a good competitive price close to what you’d pay building the system yourself. I am very happy with my latest build and was very happy with my Ironside 2020 PC build. I plans to stick with Ironside for future builds and upgrades.

monarchReviews.name: John
monarchReviews.title: Great support.
monarchReviews.body: Was having an issue with my order, and contacted support. They were quick to respond and helped me with my order. Very good support, and are open to questions that you have about your order.

monarchReviews.name: Nicole Don
monarchReviews.title: Second time doing this
monarchReviews.body: Ordered a PC from ironside a good 5-6 years ago and finally started to become outdated so made sure to come back and purchase again for a easy access updated PC and happy to say they have always been extremely reliable in getting the job done and it to me fast

monarchReviews.name: Kevin Zhao
monarchReviews.title: Incredible PC
monarchReviews.body: This PC is hands-down the best custom PC I’ve ever seen. It’s clear that Ironside has taken absolutely no shortcuts and is truly driven to create builds a tier above the rest. I am very happy with my purchase, and would definitely recommend.

monarchReviews.name: Chris Thayer
monarchReviews.title: Go To For Computers!
monarchReviews.body: Couple weeks my friend said he wanted to get his first PC. I knew I had to recommend Ironside, last week I helped him buy his first PC. He's been over the moon with it.

monarchReviews.name: Dylon Tomlinson Jr
monarchReviews.title: PC is phenomenal but Customer service lacking a bit
monarchReviews.body: PC was built professionally and packaged safely as well. No major current issues with my build but I had a concern that has not been addressed regarding a setting or two. Overall, pretty happy, just need a response from Customer Service in a timely fashion.

monarchReviews.name: Lucy
monarchReviews.title: Stoked with my North XL
monarchReviews.body: Ordering was easy, communication was on point, worked exactly how expected out of the box. Stoked with the purchase

monarchReviews.name: Preston
monarchReviews.title: Great Customer Service
monarchReviews.body: My PC was sent back to deal with some issues that occurred during shipping - the return shipping was easy and convenient - and customer service was incredibly helpful in assisting me in figuring out what additions I could have them add on at no extra cost (other than the cost of the items themselves). Thank you so much for your time and assistance, Mackenzie!

monarchReviews.name: rickv77001
monarchReviews.title: Very pleased with the build, the options, the service
monarchReviews.body: Bought a higher-end gaming / AI PC for my lad as a college graduation gift.  Price was comparable to the bigger machines on Amazon, and the customization was excellent.  I called in to see if the cooling we were selecting was proper.  Customer support was superb.  No cross-sell/upsell.  My lad didn't care for the fancy LED lighting, so we settled on a simple case with non-LED fans.  Buy the more expensive motherboard.  Ours turned out to be a Gigabyte.  The RTX 5070 Ti was the best price/performance point.  Packing was superb.  Fan noise is low.  Their W11 install is bloat-free.  Enjoy.

monarchReviews.name: Christopher Thornsberry
monarchReviews.title: Worth it
monarchReviews.body: Spencer with customer service was great he helped alot, answering any and all questions. PC runs smooth and looks great.

monarchReviews.name: Clint Davis
monarchReviews.title: Beautiful Case
monarchReviews.body: Saw the case on social media, have been looking forward to creating a new PC build for myself, and while I cannot comment yet on ease of building with, I look forward to it!

monarchReviews.name: Dom
monarchReviews.title: The Dream Build Animation Workstation
monarchReviews.body: It completes the build and makes the PC stand out from the others. I love to stare at the computer while I'm playing my favorite game or working on a new animation.

monarchReviews.name: Elvino da Silveira
monarchReviews.title: Easy Set-Up and Quick Delivery
monarchReviews.body: I had a very positive experience with Ironside PC. It was very easy to get my computer, and they had fulfilled my order faster than expected.

monarchReviews.name: Luis
monarchReviews.title: It's great
monarchReviews.body: The PC came overly protected during shipping. I was concerned about it coming in one piece but it did. So far no issues with the pc at all and runs perfectly

monarchReviews.name: Angela Liang
monarchReviews.title: Couldn’t resist the case
monarchReviews.body: The case was so cute I had to!

monarchReviews.name: Neard
monarchReviews.title: Love the PC
monarchReviews.body: It’s a great pc! I already love it while I only have it one week. I would buy one again with that case!

monarchReviews.name: Anna Harbin
monarchReviews.title: Best Decision Ever!!!
monarchReviews.body: If I had to do it over again, I would choose Ironside every single time!! I love my PC so so so much! It runs so smooth and I can game AND do graphic design on it!! Not to mention, the case is gorgeous and they shipped it super nicely. I love my Ironside computer!!
monarchReviews.product: Custom Built Eden Veil AMD PC

monarchReviews.name: Neira
monarchReviews.title: Cutest Designs EVER
monarchReviews.body: The quality and effort put into their Juicebox case designs are unmatched. Truly, the team at Ironside did an incredible job with the first round and exceeded my expectations with the new bigger versions of the Juiceboxes! 10/10!

monarchReviews.name: Aidan
monarchReviews.title: Tis good
monarchReviews.body: Its nice has space and looks good

monarchReviews.name: Luke Sale
monarchReviews.title: Intel platinum
monarchReviews.body: Love my computer and customer support here! 10/10 recommend

monarchReviews.name: Roberto Esquivel
monarchReviews.title: Good value and easy to order
monarchReviews.body: I had a easy time customizing the pc and ironside did a wonderful job putting it together worth the price and the wait.

monarchReviews.name: Alex
monarchReviews.title: Excellent PC
monarchReviews.body: Excellent quality PC that is everything you could ask for. Build quality is great, performance is exceptional, all while being extremely quiet and cool. Would recommend if you're looking for a high quality custom build.

monarchReviews.name: Heath
monarchReviews.title: Cute PC :]
monarchReviews.body: Performs very well, got here safely and in a decent time frame. Very happy with my purchase :]

monarchReviews.name: Trey
monarchReviews.title: Got my homie his first pc
monarchReviews.body: Got one of my best friends his first pc so we could play games together with some of my other good friends and it’s been amazing works beautifully for him, really quiet well built

monarchReviews.name: Bradley Butler
monarchReviews.title: Amazing build quality
monarchReviews.body: I saw this pc case in a ad and had to get my hands on it, the photos they give you don’t do it justice on the stunning look of it in person, definitely worth the money and wait

monarchReviews.name: Cheryl
monarchReviews.title: Edens Veil custom PC
monarchReviews.body: Computer arrived very fast with zero issues. Packaging was very secure and wiring was organized.

monarchReviews.name: Claire Sweet
monarchReviews.title: Extremely fast service
monarchReviews.body: Really streamlined process, was assembled and shipped incredibly quickly once everything cleared and it came in perfect working order

monarchReviews.name: Joshua
monarchReviews.title: Definitely worth the price
monarchReviews.body: I build my first computer from scratch and it worked wonders for years, but once I saw that Ironside can assemble whatever parts you choose for almost the same price as the parts themselves I just had to make the leap and I am glad I did!

monarchReviews.name: Kenneth Tant
monarchReviews.title: Awesome PC
monarchReviews.body:
I love the computer. My wife was thrilled with it and everything is working great on our end. 

My only complaint is that no one notified us when it shipped. Other than that, everything was fast, professional, and easy. We will be purchasing from ironside again.

monarchReviews.name: R
monarchReviews.title: Worth Every Penny
monarchReviews.body:
I couldn't be happier with the custom-built PC I received. The build quality is top-notch. Every cable is cleanly managed, the system runs quietly. PC also came with extra cables if needed in the future.

Highly recommend if your looking for a custom build done right.

monarchReviews.name: Preston
monarchReviews.title: Beautiful PC
monarchReviews.body:
The tower case is absolutely gorgeous, the inside is clean, the wires are obviously professionally arranged. I couldn't be happier. Unfortunately, something went wrong with shipping, and I need to send it back for them to look it over, but the customer service has been prompt and communicative.

I would for sure recommend them to anyone looking for not only a functional PC at a reasonable price, but something beautiful on your desk.

monarchReviews.name: Mat
monarchReviews.title: AMD Platinum
monarchReviews.body: This is the 3rd desktop I have ordered from Ironside with no regrets. The CS interactions I have had have always been helpful and the computers always run as I expect them with the chosen parts.

monarchReviews.name: Adrian Bermudez
monarchReviews.title: It's Everything I never knew I wanted
monarchReviews.body: I got the Limited Edition Milkbox Intel Platinum PC and it has a STRAW like a milk carton!! Incredible! Peak experience. It's a magnet too I can move it anywhere on the PC I want! Performance is crazy, I'm always iffy about buying a prebuild but this one had awesome specs for the price It's an overpay but also I don't have to build it myself. Intel Core ultra 7, 64 gb ram, 2tb storage, GeForce RTX 5070Ti. I have had no problems, all my games run amazing, way better than my last 2 prebuilds both of which gave me huge issues. THIS ONE IS PERFECT!! I bought TWO!! For me and my wife matching computer set! Don't waste your money buying from any other seller, this one has quality control, good communication, excellent performance!

monarchReviews.name: Jeremiah
monarchReviews.title: Frostvine experianxw
monarchReviews.body: Overall my experience was extremely good. The shipping was fast and product came without a single scratch. Fits my full sized atx board and larger cpu cooler(be quiet! Dark rock pro 4) with room to spare. The cable management is fantastic. Overall extremely happy

monarchReviews.name: Justin Harmon
monarchReviews.title: Worth The Wait
monarchReviews.body: This is my first computer and I’ve had amazing performance whilst at high quality so far and the inly issue I had was the power cord being forgotten originally, however they shipped me one out upon request with no cost.
monarchReviews.product: Fractal Pop XL Air - Black TG Intel Gold

monarchReviews.name: L
monarchReviews.title: Worth it so far.
monarchReviews.body:
So far PC runs well, is quiet, and remains cools.  Case is lovely, and the set up instructions are thorough.  I bought it pre-built, and every manual for each piece was included, as well as extra cabling if needed.  The only issue I had with my order was that I didn't receive a notification when the items shipped, nor did I receive an estimated date--I was texted by a mail carrier and thought it was a scam, because I couldn't find proof from Ironside that my computer shipped.  It worked out fine, however, and it was the only dark spot on my purchase.

Overall, it has been worth it so far, and I'm glad I purchased.

monarchReviews.name: Frances G
monarchReviews.title: Cute and Functional
monarchReviews.body: I bought the strawberry juice box case during the first wave and have loved it since. So excited it’s been rereleased, definitely grab one if you can! Glad they listed to all their customers and made a straw to go with it, I grabbed one as soon as it was released and they go perfectly together 💛
monarchReviews.product: Strawberry Juice Box Case and Magnetic Straw

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
